title: Darling Keeps the Goal of Running macOS Software on Linux in View
dek: The Darling project is working on a compatibility layer intended to let some macOS software run on Linux, a technically ambitious effort with practical limits for teams evaluating cross-platform workflows.
socialCaption: Darling is pursuing a Wine-like ambition for macOS software on Linux. The opportunity is real for targeted tools and workflows—but teams should validate compatibility application by application before treating it as production infrastructure.
